Name: Expanded Farm - Hidden Forest - MTN Map
Author: LePheel
Description:
This mod adds an expansion to the main farm, increasing the area from 80x65 tiles to 90x90, providing a beautiful new scenery, and significantly more area for farming (and activities!).

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]90x90 tiles of sprawling area (almost twice the area of the default map)
[*]Lots of hardwood (not yet respawning, will updated to mirror respawning on Forest map)
[*]Lovely streams and rivers with fish (to be updated with special fish, similar to the Riverlands map)
[*]A spa to recharge after a long day (optional use)
[/list]

[b][color=#ffd966][size=3]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2256]MTN[/url][/size][/color]

[/b]Install Instructions:
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2256]MTN[/url]﻿
[*]Place the Forest map folder in the Mods folder like any other mod

[/list]
You're good to go! The map should appear at the end of the selection screen.

[b][color=#ff0000]Reporting Bugs:[/color]
Please use the Nexus Bug report section instead of posts. Always include your latest logs if you want help: [url=https://log.smapi.io/]Upload your logs here[/url]
[/b] 
Open for feedback and changes (but no promises)!
